title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) / Modified Interest Subvention Scheme (MISS)
content: Provides flexible credit limits based on cropping pattern and landholding. The baseline interest rate is 7% per annum on credit up to ₹3,00,000, with a 3% prompt-repayment incentive bringing the effective rate down to 4%. The collateral-free loan limit is ₹1.60 lakh, expandable up to ₹3 lakh for tie-up arrangements.
source: RBI Master Circular on Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme

title: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) & PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
content: Low-cost social security schemes linked to rural bank accounts. PMSBY provides ₹2 lakh accidental death or disability cover for a premium of ₹20 per year. PMJJBY provides ₹2 lakh life cover for a premium of ₹436 per year.
source: Dept. of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
content: A guaranteed monthly pension scheme for unorganized rural workers and smallholder farmers, providing ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60. The pension amount depends on the subscriber's entry age, which must be between 18 and 40 years.
